 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Nov 04, 2026, 10:49:07 IST SUMMARY Michigan Election Results 2026 Live: Updates from the US midterm elections in Michigan, where the November 3 ballot includes a US Senate race, a governor's race and all 13 US House seats. The Senate contest is between Democrat Abdul El-Sayed and Republican Mike Rogers. The governor's race is between Democrat Jocelyn Benson and Republican John James. Live Events 
 10:49 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: What is at stake for the second half of the term The midterms decide the political conditions for the last two years of the president's term.
 Which party sets the legislative agenda
 How smoothly nominees are approved
 How much oversight the administration faces
 Michigan contributes to that outcome through a Senate seat, the governorship and 13 House seats.
 10:44 (IST) Nov 04 Republican Lisa McClain wins reelection to US House in Michigan's 9th Congressional District Republican incumbent Lisa McClain won re-election to the US House from Michigan's 9th Congressional District, retaining the seat for her party. First elected in 2020, she has represented Michigan in Congress since January 2021 and is set to begin her fourth term. She currently serves as chair of the House Republican Conference. 
 US Midterm Elections 2026
 House Senate Governor Source: AP Votecast View Details 10:37 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: Why control of Congress matters for federal spending Congress holds the power over federal spending.
 The majority controls the committees that write budgets.
 In a divided government, budgets need bipartisan deals.
 Spending fights can stall other legislation.
 Federal spending decisions reach Michigan like every other state.
 10:31 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Governor Election Results 2026: Whitmer flipped the governorship in 2018 by 9.5 points In 2018, Democrat Gretchen Whitmer won the open-seat governor's race in Michigan with 2,266,193 votes (53.3%), defeating Republican Bill Schuette, who received 1,859,534 votes (43.8%). Whitmer won by 406,659 votes, a margin of 9.5 percentage points. The governorship flipped from Republican to Democratic control.
 10:29 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Governor Election Results 2026: Whitmer's term limit opens the governor's office Michigan is choosing a new governor because Gretchen Whitmer cannot run again.
 Whitmer, a Democrat, is term-limited.
 Democratic secretary of state Jocelyn Benson is her party's candidate.
 Republican congressman John James is the opponent.
 The governor's race carries national significance as well as state stakes.
 10:26 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republican vs Democrat, House results Of Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races, 7 have been called and all 13 are reporting. Republican candidates have won 3 seats and are leading in 3 more. Democratic candidates have won 4 seats and are leading in 3 more. Republicans hold a vote share of 47.21% against 50.72% for Democrats, with 40.31% of the expected vote counted across these races. Daily Puzzles

 Lite Challenge Play Now 10:25 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: Why the Senate matters for judicial nominees The Senate approves the president's judicial nominees.
 With a friendly Senate, nominees are approved smoothly.
 With an opposition Senate, every nominee becomes a negotiation.
 Michigan has a say in that through its Senate race.
 10:22 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Senate Election Results 2026: Why this seat matters for the president's agenda Control of the Senate decides how much the president can get done in the second half of the term.
 A Senate in the president's party approves judicial nominees smoothly.
 It also helps pass major legislation.
 An opposition Senate makes bipartisan deals necessary.
 Michigan's seat is one of the 35 that decide which way that goes.
 10:16 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: Foreign policy and energy in the midterm debate Global events and domestic energy policy shaped voter sentiment during the campaign.
 Foreign policy and security featured in the national debate.
 Energy policy affects prices that voters feel directly.
 These were national questions rather than Michigan-specific ones this year.
 10:16 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Democrats vs GOP, House results Seven of Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races have been called, with all 13 reporting. Democratic candidates have won 4 seats and are leading in 4 more; Republican candidates have won 3 seats and are leading in 2 more. No other party has won or is leading in any House race in Michigan. Democrats hold a vote share of 50.89% against 47.03% for Republicans, with 37.6% of the expected vote counted across these races. 10:07 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026: A Trump state in 2024 that often swings Michigan's recent record makes it a test for both parties.
 Michigan voted for Trump in the 2024 presidential election.
 The state has frequently swung between the parties.
 The 2026 vote tests whether Republicans can keep that support.
 The Senate and governor's results will show how much of the 2024 shift held.
 10:05 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Senate Election Results 2026: Stabenow won the 2018 Senate race by 6.5 points In 2018, incumbent Democrat Debbie Stabenow won the Senate race in Michigan with 2,214,478 votes (52.3%), defeating Republican John James, who received 1,938,818 votes (45.8%). Stabenow won by 275,660 votes, a margin of 6.5 percentage points. Democrats held the seat.
 10:04 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: Two ways Congress could go The national result comes down to two broad outcomes.
 Outcome What follows 
 President's party keeps Congress Major legislation and judicial nominees move smoothly 
 Opposition takes a chamber Divided government, gridlock, subpoenas and investigations 
 Michigan's results are one part of the national total that decides between them.
 10:03 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: Four factors that shaped the 2026 midterms Four big factors shaped these midterms across the country.
 Economic conditions: cost of living, inflation, housing, jobs.
 Redistricting and gerrymandering in states such as Texas, California and North Carolina.
 Foreign policy, security and energy policy.
 Social issues, including reproductive rights, voting laws and education.
 Each of them plays out in some form in Michigan.
 10:01 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Governor Election Results 2026: What a governor controls Governors are the key state executives in the US system.
 They influence election laws.
 They shape abortion legislation.
 They oversee local budgets.
 Whoever leads Michigan after this election controls those levers for the next term.
 09:59 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: Three appointed senators facing voters Three senators on the 2026 ballot were appointed to their seats rather than elected.
 Florida: Republican Ashley Moody was appointed to the Senate after Marco Rubio became secretary of state.
 Ohio: Republican Jon Husted was appointed to replace Vice-President JD Vance.
 South Carolina: Republican Darline Graham was appointed to the Senate after the death of her brother, Lindsey Graham.
 Each of them is asking voters to confirm an appointment.
 09:59 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Democrat vs GOP, House results As of the latest updates, six of Michigan's 13 House races have been decided, with all 13 reporting. Democratic candidates have secured victory in 4 seats and are currently leading in 3 additional races. Republican candidates have won 2 seats and are leading in 4 more. No other political parties have won or are leading in any of the House races. Across these contests, Democrats have garnered 50.89% of the vote compared to 47.02% for Republicans, with 32.73% of the expected vote having been tallied. 09:45 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026: Michigan: Democratic senators and governor after every election since 2018 Democrats held both of Michigan's Senate seats and the governorship after all four elections. Elissa Slotkin succeeded Debbie Stabenow in 2025; Gary Peters, who holds the other seat, is retiring, and Gretchen Whitmer is term-limited.
 09:44 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republican vs Democrat, House results Six of Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races have been called, with all 13 reporting. Republican candidates have won 2 seats and are leading in 5 more. Democratic candidates have won 4 seats and are leading in 2 more. No other party has won or is leading in any seat. Republicans hold a vote share of 46.11% across these races against 51.77% for Democrats, with 30% of the expected vote counted. 09:39 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Senate Election Results 2026: One of 35 Senate seats on the ballot Thirty-five of the Senate's 100 seats are on the ballot in 2026.
 33 of them are regular elections.
 Two are special elections, in Florida and Ohio.
 Michigan's contest is a regular election.
 Senators serve six-year terms, so only about a third of the chamber faces voters at a time.
 09:27 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: Florida and Ohio hold the two special Senate elections Two of the 35 Senate contests this year are special elections.
 Florida: Republican Ashley Moody and Democrat Angie Nixon.
 Ohio: Republican Jon Husted and Democrat Sherrod Brown.
 Both seats are held by appointed Republican senators seeking to keep them through an election.
 09:26 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: Independent and third-party candidates in statewide races A handful of statewide races in 2026 feature a serious candidate from outside the two major parties.
 State Race Candidate 
 Idaho Senate Todd Achilles (Independent) 
 Maine Governor Rick Bennett (Independent) 
 Montana Senate Seth Bodnar (Independent) 
 Nebraska Senate Dan Osborn (Independent) 
 South Dakota Senate Brian Bengs (Independent) 
 Wyoming Governor Rebecca Bextel (Constitution Party) 
 These races are worth watching for how the major-party vote splits.
 09:24 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: GOP vs Democrats, House results Five of Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races have been called, with all 13 reporting. Republican candidates have won 1 seat and are leading in 6 others. Democratic candidates have won 4 seats and are leading in 2 others. No other party has won or is leading in any House race in Michigan. Republicans hold a vote share of 45.16% against 52.73% for Democrats, with 26.92% of the expected vote counted. 09:24 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan House Election Results 2026: Why every House seat is up every two years House members serve two-year terms, the shortest of any federal office.
 Office Term 
 US House 2 years 
 US Senate 6 years 
 Governor 4 years in most states 
 That is why all 13 of Michigan's House seats are on the ballot even in years with no other race.
 09:14 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republicans vs Democrats, House results In Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races, all have reported their results. Four seats have been called, with Democrats securing 4 wins and holding leads in 2 additional races. Republicans have not yet won any seats but are currently leading in 7. The vote share stands at 44.75% for Republican candidates and 53.1% for Democratic candidates, with 24.75% of the expected vote tallied. 09:10 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Governor Election Results 2026: One of 36 states electing a governor Governors are on the ballot in 36 states this year, plus three US territories.
 Michigan is one of the 36.
 19 of the 36 races are open contests with no incumbent running.
 26 states hold both a Senate and a governor's race.
 Governors in most states serve four-year terms.
 09:04 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republicans vs Democrats, House results In Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races, three have been called, and all 13 have reported their results. Democratic candidates have secured 3 seats and are currently leading in 3 additional races. Republican candidates have not yet won any seats but are leading in 7. Across these races, Republicans hold 43.76% of the vote, while Democrats have garnered 54.08%, with 22.57% of the expected vote having been counted. 09:02 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan House Election Results 2026: Michigan's House seats since 2018: Republicans won 7, 7, 6 and 7 Seats won by each party in Michigan's House races:
 2018: Republicans 7, Democrats 7 (of 14 seats)
 2020: Republicans 7, Democrats 7
 2022: Republicans 6, Democrats 7 (of 13 seats)
 2024: Republicans 7, Democrats 6
 Michigan lost a seat in the reapportionment after the 2020 census, from 14 to 13, starting with the 2022 election.
 08:51 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Senate Election Results 2026: What this result decides The Michigan result settles who holds this Senate seat for the next six years.
 The seat is held by Democrat Gary Peters.
 Senators serve six-year terms.
 The result counts toward control of the 100-seat Senate.
 Senate control shapes how easily the president can get judicial nominees approved.
 08:49 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republican vs Democrat, House results Of Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races, 2 have been called and all 13 are reporting. Democratic candidates have won 2 seats and are leading in 3 more. Republican candidates have won no seats but are leading in 8 races. Democrats hold a vote share of 55.2% against the Republicans' 42.64%, with 19.91% of the expected vote counted. 08:40 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: The 19 open governor's races of 2026 19 of the 36 governor's races have no incumbent running.

 08:28 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Election Results 2026: How Michigan's issues line up with the national debate Some of the issues in Michigan match the national midterm themes and some are local.
 Issue in Michigan National theme 
 Manufacturing jobs Economic conditions 
 Automobile industry Economic conditions 
 Electric vehicles Economic conditions 
 Tariffs Economic conditions 
 Healthcare Mainly a state concern 
 The four national themes this year are the economy, redistricting, foreign policy and security, and social issues.
 08:20 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: The 13 open Senate seats of 2026 13 Senate races in 2026 have no sitting senator on the ballot.

 08:07 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan House Election Results 2026: Why district maps matter in the 2026 House race Redistricting and gerrymandering are among the factors shaping the 2026 House contests.
 Mid-decade map changes in Texas, California and North Carolina have shifted structural advantages.
 District lines decide which voters are grouped together.
 Michigan's 13 districts are part of the same national count.
 Maps elsewhere change the target number every state is playing for.
 08:07 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republican vs Democrat, House results Of Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races, 2 have been called and all 13 are reporting. Democratic candidates have won 2 seats and are leading in 4 more. Republican candidates have won no seats but are leading in 7 races. Democrats hold a vote share of 56.2% against 41.62% for Republicans, with 15.63% of the expected vote counted. 08:06 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026: Michigan voted for Trump in 2024 but elected a Democratic senator Joe Biden carried Michigan by 2.8 points in 2020; Donald Trump carried it by 1.4 points in 2024.
 In the same 2024 election, Democrat Elissa Slotkin won Michigan's open Senate seat.
 08:00 (IST) Nov 04 Democrat Jeremy Moss wins Michigan's 11th Congressional District race Democrat Jeremy Moss has won the election to Michigan's 11th Congressional District, securing a seat in the US House of Representatives. A lifelong resident of Oakland County, Moss previously served in the Michigan Senate, where he rose to become president pro tempore. First elected to the state Legislature in 2015, he has championed legislation on labour rights, gun safety, housing and tax relief. He earlier served on the Southfield City Council. 07:56 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Democrats vs GOP, House results Two of Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races have been called, with 12 races reporting. Democratic candidates have won 2 seats and are leading in 4 more. Republican candidates have won no seats but are leading in 6. Democrats hold 55.78% of the vote across these races against 42.02% for Republicans, with 13.98% of the expected vote counted. 07:54 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Governor Election Results 2026: What this result decides The Michigan result decides who leads the state government.
 Governors influence state election laws.
 They shape abortion legislation at the state level.
 They set the direction of state and local budgets.
 That makes the governor's race the most direct way Michigan voters shape their own state government.
 07:46 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: The biggest House delegations in the country Eight states account for nearly half of the 435 House seats.
 State House seats 
 California 52 
 Texas 38 
 Florida 28 
 New York 26 
 Illinois 17 
 Pennsylvania 17 
 Ohio 15 
 Georgia 14 
 Michigan (rank 10) 13 
 Michigan's 13 seats are part of the same national count.
 07:46 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: GOP vs Democrats, House results Of Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races, 1 has been called and 12 are reporting. Democratic candidates have won 1 seat and are leading in 4 more. Republican candidates have won no seats but are leading in 7. Democrats hold a vote share of 55.81% against 41.99% for Republicans, with 12.8% of the expected vote counted across these races. 07:37 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Senate Election Results 2026: What a win for each side would mean The Senate result in Michigan can go more than one way, and each outcome reads differently.
 An El-Sayed win would keep the seat with Democrats.
 A Rogers win would move the seat from Democrats to Republicans.
 Either way, the result feeds into the national count.
 07:36 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republican vs Democrat, House results One of Michigan's 13 House of Representatives races has been declared, with 11 races reporting. Democratic candidates have won 1 seat and are leading in 4 more. Republican candidates have won no seats but are leading in 6 races. Democrats hold a vote share of 56.21% against 41.6% for Republicans, with 12.02% of the expected vote counted across the state's House races. 07:25 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republicans vs Democrats, House results No House race in Michigan has been called yet, with 10 of the state's 13 House races reporting. Republican candidates are leading in 6 races. Democratic candidates are leading in 4 races. Republicans have 41.8% of the vote across these races, while Democrats have 56.08%, with 9.42% of the expected vote counted. 07:22 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: One of 26 states with both Senate and governor races Michigan is one of 26 states with both a Senate and a governor's race in 2026.
 The full list: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas and Wyoming.
 These states carry the most statewide weight in this election.
 07:15 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republicans vs Democrats, House results No House race in Michigan has been called yet. Of the 13 House of Representatives races in the state, 9 are reporting and none is declared. Republican candidates are leading in 5 races, while Democratic candidates are leading in 4. Republicans hold 39.61% of the vote across these races against 58.19% for Democrats, with 8.51% of the expected vote counted. 07:15 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026: Every statewide candidate in one table The main statewide candidates in Michigan in 2026.
 Race Candidate Party Background 
 Senate Abdul El-Sayed Democratic Democratic candidate 
 Senate Mike Rogers Republican Republican candidate 
 Governor Jocelyn Benson Democratic Democratic secretary of state 
 Governor John James Republican Republican congressman 
 House candidates run separately in each of Michigan's districts.
 07:10 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan House Election Results 2026: Republican candidates took 49.0% of the statewide House vote in 2024 The statewide House vote in Michigan, adding up every district:
 2024: Republican candidates 2,702,653 votes (49.0%), Democratic candidates 2,634,228 votes (47.7%), out of 5,516,896 House votes cast
 2022: Democratic candidates 2,184,504 votes (49.9%), Republican candidates 2,083,361 votes (47.6%), out of 4,375,537 House votes cast
 2022 was the first election under district maps redrawn after the 2020 census.
 07:05 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Election Results 2026 Live Updates: Republican vs Democrat, House results No House race in Michigan has been called yet, with 8 of the 13 races reporting. Republican candidates are leading in 4 races and Democratic candidates are leading in 4 races. Democrats hold a vote share of 57.75% across these races, while Republicans stand at 40.09%, with 6.96% of the expected vote counted. 07:00 (IST) Nov 04 Michigan Midterm Elections 2026: Social issues and ballot initiatives expected to drive turnout State-level ballot initiatives were expected to bring out voters on both sides this year.
 Reproductive rights
 Voting laws
 Education
 These initiatives were part of the national backdrop to the Michigan vote.
 31 More Updates Load More Michigan Midterm Election Results 2026 Live: Michigan voted for Trump in the 2024 presidential election. The Senate race is open because Democratic senator Gary Peters is retiring. The governor's race is open because Democratic governor Gretchen Whitmer is term-limited. Several House districts in Michigan were seen as highly competitive. Results from the November 3 vote arrive in India through November 4.
